# miragea-skills

> Open-source Agent Skills (SKILL.md folders) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents that add voiceover, captions and video-narration abilities, powered by the Miragea voice and speech-recognition API (https://miragea.ai/v1). Python standard library + ffmpeg; MIT licensed.

## Skills
- [video-captions](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/video-captions): caption any video or audio into readable SRT/VTT (whole words, 42-char lines) and burn captions into MP4, including 1-3 word Shorts/Reels/TikTok captions. `python3 scripts/captions.py input.mp4 --burn`
- [remotion-narration](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/remotion-narration): script to per-scene voiceover MP3s, measured durations as Remotion durationInFrames, word-level Remotion Caption[] JSON and SRT. `python3 scripts/narrate.py script.md --voice VOICE_ID`

- [screen-recording-voiceover](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/screen-recording-voiceover): add a timed AI voiceover to a silent screen recording; finds steps, voices one line per step, auto speed-up or freeze-frame when a line runs long, ducked music, SRT/VTT, burned captions. `python3 scripts/voiceover.py demo.mp4 demo.script.txt --voice VOICE_ID`
- [shorts-voiceover](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/shorts-voiceover): text script to a finished 1080x1920 YouTube Short / TikTok / Reel with voiceover, captions timed from the real speech, Ken Burns images or B-roll or gradients, ducked music, -14 LUFS. `python3 scripts/short.py script.txt --voice VOICE_ID`
- [video-to-shorts](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/video-to-shorts): AI clip maker and open-source Opus Clip alternative; long video (podcast, webinar, stream VOD) to captioned 1080x1920 YouTube Shorts/TikToks/Reels, agent-picked moments, sentence-safe cuts, crop or blurred fill, -14 LUFS, optional spoken hook in a cloned voice. `python3 scripts/clips.py render talk.mp4 talk.clips.json`
- [hook-variants](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/hook-variants): A/B test the first 3 seconds of a Short, TikTok, Reel or ad; voices 4-6 hooks in the same AI voice, trimmed, -14 LUFS, measured length with a budget flag. `python3 scripts/hooks.py hooks.txt --budget 3`
- [video-dubbing](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/video-dubbing): AI video dubbing and video translation in your own cloned voice (own-voice dubbing); agent translates each line within a time budget, lines start on the original, max 1.2x speed-up, music kept in pauses, translated SRT, -14 LUFS, full-length audio track for YouTube multi-language audio. Open-source alternative to ElevenLabs Dubbing / HeyGen video translation. `python3 scripts/dub.py render talk.mp4 talk.es.dub.json`

- [auto-broll](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/auto-broll): automatic B-roll for talking-head videos, podcasts, tutorials and faceless videos; the agent picks cutaways from a word-timed transcript, every cut lands on the spoken word, speaker audio untouched, cover-crop 16:9/9:16, Ken Burns stills, editorial checks (hook, flash cuts, coverage), MP4 + CMX 3600 EDL for Premiere/Resolve; own clips or free Pexels stock; faceless mode voices a script in a cloned voice. `python3 scripts/broll.py render talk.mp4 talk.broll.json`
- [ugc-video-ads](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/ugc-video-ads): UGC-style video ads for TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts and Meta without a video model; agent writes 3-5 hooks and a direct-response body, every hook x body voiced in your own cloned voice, captions and overlays in platform safe zones, end card + CTA, 3-second hook budget, ad-claim lint, 9:16/4:5/1:1, -14 LUFS, manifest for Ads Manager. `python3 scripts/ads.py render ad.json --ratios 9:16,4:5`
- [audiogram-clips](https://github.com/yyert123/miragea-skills/tree/main/audiogram-clips): podcast to video / audiogram maker; captioned animated waveform MP4 from any audio clip for TikTok, Shorts, Reels, LinkedIn, X; Miragea ASR captions, cover art, 4 aspect ratios. `python3 scripts/audiogram.py clip.mp3 -o clip.mp4`
## Facts
- Requires MIRAGEA_API_KEY (environment variable). Keys are never printed or stored.
- Captions cost 3 Miragea points per audio second; speech is billed per character; cached re-runs are free.
- Voice: a saved Miragea voice id, or a public reference clip URL (with consent).
- Install: `npx skills add yyert123/miragea-skills` or copy a skill folder into your agent's skills directory.
- jump-cut-editor: remove silences, filler words and repeated words from video/audio using word timing; dry-run shows time saved
- voice-patch: replace one phrase in a video narration with cloned-voice speech, video untouched
